lines.en: label dormwar15:
{i}One hour later, at Sara’s bar...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一小时后，在 Sara 的酒吧……{/i}

lines.en: scene fashionshow1
I wind up getting a ride to the bar from...someone employed by the Tsukiokas after our dinner comes to an end.
lines.zh: 晚餐结束后，我最后是搭……月冈家雇的某个人的车去的酒吧。

lines.en: Touka, not wanting to show her extraordinarily revealing dress to the rest of the girls in her class, heads back home to get changed before coming back for the “final” contest of the dorm war.
lines.zh: Touka 不想让班上其他女生看到她那件格外暴露的裙子，于是先回家换了衣服，再赶回来参加宿舍大战的“最后”一场比赛。

lines.en: And I say “final” like that because I still have no idea what Yumi and Io are doing.
lines.zh: 我之所以把“最后”说成这样，是因为我到现在还不知道 Yumi 和 Io 在搞什么名堂。

lines.en: But I’ve been told this is the last contest, so...I’m just going to believe it because that makes everything significantly easier.
lines.zh: 但别人告诉我这就是最后一场比赛了，所以……我就信了吧，毕竟这样一切都会简单很多。

lines.en: Also, look- people my age.
lines.zh: 另外，你看——跟我年纪差不多的人。

lines.en: : Hello, fellow adults.
lines.zh: : 你们好啊，各位成年人同胞。

lines.en: : Greetings, human male. Will you be partaking in any of the alcohols today?
lines.zh: : 你好啊，人类男性。今天要不要来点酒精饮料？

lines.en: : I’m already buzzed so I’m just going to talk like an actual person, if that’s okay with you guys.
lines.zh: : 我已经有点上头了，所以我打算像个正常人一样说话，你们不介意吧。

lines.en: : Works for me. How long have you two been here?
lines.zh: : 我没意见。你们俩来多久了？

lines.en: : Maybe an hour or two?
lines.zh: : 大概一两个小时吧？

lines.en: : Makoto told me that the final part of the dorm war was going to take place here, so I figured I’d be a good adult and watch over everyone as they get intoxicated.
lines.zh: : Makoto 跟我说宿舍大战的最后一部分会在这里举行，所以我想着要做个称职的成年人，看着大家喝醉。

lines.en: : While also getting partially intoxicated myself because, come on. Wine is good.
lines.zh: : 顺便自己也要稍微喝一点，因为拜托，红酒真好喝。

lines.en: : How’s the whole contest for your body thing going?
lines.zh: : 你那个“争夺身体”的比赛进行得怎么样了？

lines.en: : I just got back from a date with a girl who is far too developed for her age, so pretty good.
lines.zh: : 我刚和一个发育得远超年龄的女孩约会回来，所以相当不错。

lines.en: scene fashionshow2
: Yeah, what’s the deal with that? How come girls now are growing up so quickly and we were total dweebs at their age?
lines.zh: : 对啊，这到底是怎么回事？为什么现在的女孩子长得这么快，我们在她们那个年纪的时候却土得掉渣？

lines.en: : I don’t know, but...
lines.zh: : 我不知道，不过……

lines.en: : I’m probably not drunk enough to really share my full thoughts on that matter right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在大概还没醉到能把对这件事的全部想法都说出来。

lines.en: : Just drink more then. I’ll drive you home.
lines.zh: : 那就多喝点。我送你回家。

lines.en: : Please don’t get me drunk. I have to work in the morning.
lines.zh: : 别把我灌醉好不好。我早上还得上班。

lines.en: : But if I don’t get you drunk, how am I supposed to take advantage of you?
lines.zh: : 可我要是不把你灌醉，要怎么占你便宜啊？

lines.en: : Oh, right. You two are lesbians when you drink.
lines.zh: : 哦对。你们俩一喝酒就变成女同。

lines.en: scene fashionshow3
: You’re free to come if you’d like! Just leave several minutes after me so Makoto doesn’t think I’m going home with her teacher.
lines.zh: : 你想来的话尽管来！只要比我晚走几分钟就行，免得 Makoto 以为我要跟她老师一起回家。

lines.en: : That sounds great...but I don’t think I’m really allowed to leave tonight.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错……不过我今晚大概是走不了的。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re judging some...what was it? A fashion show, I think?
lines.zh: : 对啊，你要去当什么……叫什么来着？时装秀的评委吧？

lines.en: : Is that what’s going on? How do you know that?
lines.zh: : 是要办这个吗？你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Molly told me about it. She was complaining about not being able to find enough fabric or something.
lines.zh: : Molly 跟我说的。她还在抱怨找不到足够的布料什么的。

lines.en: Damn it. There goes the dream of the nude photo shoot I thought up yesterday.
lines.zh: 可恶。我昨天想出来的裸体写真的点子就这么泡汤了。

lines.en: Granted, I doubt Sara would let her daughter do something like that and-
lines.zh: 话说回来，我也怀疑 Sara 不会让她女儿做那种事，而且——

lines.en: Actually...
lines.zh: 不过嘛……

lines.en: : Attention, everyone! Please direct your attention to the front of the room!
lines.zh: : 大家注意！请把目光转向房间前方！

lines.en: scene fashionshow4
I turn around to find Makoto and Uta standing on some stage they must have thrown together just for today.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看见 Makoto 和 Uta 站在一个应该是她们专门为今天搭起来的舞台上。

lines.en: I have no idea how these girls were able to coordinate such a well produced competition in less than 48 hours, but they do weird shit all the time, so I guess it makes sense.
lines.zh: 我真不知道这些女孩是怎么在不到 48 小时里策划出这么一场像模像样的比赛的，不过她们本来就整天搞些莫名其妙的事，所以好像也说得通。

lines.en: Also, the world resets every few months and I can talk to birds. So there’s really no reason to question something like how quickly they could build a stage.
lines.zh: 再说了，这世界每隔几个月就会重置一次，我还能跟鸟说话。所以像她们搭舞台有多快这种事，实在没什么好怀疑的。

lines.en: : Thank you to all who showed up to the main event of the first ever Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 感谢各位前来观看第一届超级无敌究极宿舍大战的主赛事！

lines.en: : It’s been a heck of a competition so far! Some friendships have been made, some have ended!
lines.zh: : 到目前为止这比赛真是够劲！有人结下了友谊，也有人友谊破裂！

lines.en: : As far as I know, there are no friendships that have ended. But if there are, please try to work out your differences!
lines.zh: : 据我所知，没有任何友谊破裂。不过如果真有，请大家努力化解分歧！

lines.en: : That’s right, Makoto! The whole idea of this contest was bondage after all!
lines.zh: : 说得对，Makoto！这场比赛的初衷本来就是 bondage（捆绑）嘛！

lines.en: : {i}Bonding,{/i} Uta.
lines.zh: : 是 {i}bonding（联谊）{/i}，Uta。

lines.en: : Same thing! Point is, I’m really glad we all got to spend so much time together...and I hope it means that we can all be better friends from now on!
lines.zh: : 都差不多啦！重点是，我真的很高兴大家能一起度过这么多时间……也希望这能让我们从今往后成为更好的朋友！

lines.en: : Oh, and whichever team wins Sensei is allowed to tie him up and stuff and he’s not allowed to say no!
lines.zh: : 哦对了，哪一队赢了，就可以把老师绑起来随便怎么样，而且他不许说不！

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: scene fashionshow5
: Wait, you didn’t {i}actually{/i} mean bondage, did you?
lines.zh: : 等等，你说的该不会{i}真的{/i}是 bondage 那个意思吧？

lines.en: : Because there are...many issues that would arise from that.
lines.zh: : 因为那样的话……会引出很多问题。

lines.en: : That’s my girl! Teach her all about the proper way to fasten harnesses, just like your momma taught {i}you{/i}!
lines.zh: : 不愧是我女儿！就像你妈妈教{i}你{/i}的那样，好好教教大家怎么正确系束具！

lines.en: scene fashionshow6
: Mom, stop! That’s not what I meant!
lines.zh: : 妈，别说了！我不是那个意思！

lines.en: : Hold onto your seats, gang!
lines.zh: : 大家坐稳了！

lines.en: : In just a few minutes, we’ll have Sana and Yasu come out and show off their outfits!
lines.zh: : 再过几分钟，Sana 和 Yasu 就会登场展示她们的服装！

lines.en: : Then, Sensei will pick the one who he wants to take home and do weird stuff to the most!
lines.zh: : 然后，老师会选出他最想带回家、最想对她做奇怪事情的那一个！

lines.en: : Aaaaaaand that’s limited only to the two contestants, right?
lines.zh: : 那那那那这个只限于两位参赛者吧？

lines.en: : Right! So keep your heckin’ pants on, Noriko! He ain’t your onii-chan anymore!
lines.zh: : 没错！所以你给我把裤子穿好喽，Noriko！他再也不是你哥哥了！

lines.en: : What sort of “weird things” is Sensei going to do to the winner of the competition?
lines.zh: : 老师要对比赛的获胜者做哪种“奇怪的事情”？

lines.en: : Absolutely nothing if he knows what’s good for him.
lines.zh: : 只要他还想活命，就什么也不会做。

lines.en: : Sensei! How long are you going to wait before saying hi to me?
lines.zh: : 老师！你还要等多久才来跟我打招呼？

lines.en: scene fashionshow7
: I was on my way...There are just like six million people here.
lines.zh: : 我正准备过去……这里人实在太多了，大概有六百万个吧。

lines.en: : I know! It’s the most business I’ve had in years!
lines.zh: : 我知道！这是我这几年生意最好的一天！

lines.en: : I mean, sure, many of them aren’t old enough to drink. But hey, business is business right?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，当然啦，她们很多人还没到能喝酒的年纪。不过话说回来，生意归生意嘛，对吧？

lines.en: : And Maki already said she’ll watch over them all, so everyone is safe!
lines.zh: : 而且 Maki 已经说了她会看着所有人，所以大家都很安全！

lines.en: : Are you actually selling alcohol to the girls?
lines.zh: : 你真的在卖酒给那些女孩？

lines.en: : Oh, not at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，完全没有。

lines.en: : Not until the fashion show is over, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，在时装秀结束之前不会卖。

lines.en: : I don’t want Sana tripping and getting hurt while she’s up there. You know how she gets when she’s drunk.
lines.zh: : 我可不想 Sana 在上面绊倒受伤。你知道她喝醉之后是什么样子。

lines.en: : It’s a miracle that you’re still in business, Sara.
lines.zh: : 你这家店居然还开着，真是个奇迹，Sara。

lines.en: : It’s less of a miracle and more of a matter of Wakana spending half of her salary on beer.
lines.zh: : 与其说是奇迹，不如说是 Wakana 把一半工资都花在啤酒上了。

lines.en: : It’s the only way to kill the pain.
lines.zh: : 这是唯一能麻痹痛苦的方法。

lines.en: : You know these two?
lines.zh: : 你认识这两位？

lines.en: : Yeah. The one with the scarf is Osako Osaka, my karate instructor. And the one that looks like a zombie is Wakana Watabe, a coworker of mine.
lines.zh: : 嗯。围围巾那位是 Osako Osaka，我的空手道教练。看起来像僵尸那位是 Wakana Watabe，我的同事。

lines.en: scene fashionshow8
: You do karate? No wonder you’re in such great shape.
lines.zh: : 你在练空手道？难怪身材这么好。

lines.en: : He...tries.
lines.zh: : 他……有在练。

lines.en: : Actually, no. He doesn’t even try. He just talks to that blonde girl over on the couch the whole time.
lines.zh: : 不对，其实他根本没在练。他全程都在跟沙发那边那个金发女孩说话。

lines.en: : {i}She{/i} tries, though. In fact, she’s pretty good while he’s not distracting her.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}她{/i}倒是很认真。事实上，只要他不打扰她，她练得相当不错。

lines.en: scene fashionshow9
: So you teach [teenager]s {i}and{/i} adults?
lines.zh: : 所以你既教[teenager]s，{i}也{/i}教成年人？

lines.en: : Whoever, really.
lines.zh: : 谁来都教，真的。

lines.en: : She also works at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 她还在女仆咖啡厅打工。

lines.en: scene fashionshow10
: Ah! I knew you looked familiar!
lines.zh: : 啊！我就说你看着眼熟！

lines.en: : Oh my God, you look so different without the costume!
lines.zh: : 天哪，你不穿那身衣服差别也太大了！

lines.en: : Didn’t we agree you wouldn’t talk about that to anyone?
lines.zh: : 我们不是说好你不会跟任何人提这件事的吗？

lines.en: : It’s fine. Sara is a bartender. She basically exists to hear peoples’ secrets.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Sara 是调酒师。她存在的意义基本上就是听别人的秘密。

lines.en: : It’s true, you know. Anything you say in here is totally confidential. But you shouldn’t be embarrassed about the maid thing!
lines.zh: : 是真的哦。在这里说的任何事都绝对保密。不过你也不用为女仆的事害羞啦！

lines.en: : You were really, really cute!
lines.zh: : 你真的、真的超可爱！

lines.en: : Like {i}really{/i} cute!
lines.zh: : 是{i}真的{/i}很可爱！

lines.en: scene fashionshow11
: I get it, okay?! You don’t have to keep telling me!
lines.zh: : 我知道了啦！你不用一直讲！

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} love that outfit on you.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}很喜欢你穿那身衣服的样子。

lines.en: scene fashionshow12
: Ahh! Just leave me alone! I don’t want to hear it!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！别管我了！我不想听！

lines.en: scene fashionshow13
: Alright, everybody! The contestants are ready to show you how cute they are!
lines.zh: : 好了，各位！参赛选手已经准备好要让大家看看她们有多可爱了！

lines.en: : But first, why don’t we check in with the people who made the costumes and see how they’re feeling about the whole ordeal...starting with floor numero uno!
lines.zh: : 不过首先，我们不如先问问做这些衣服的人，看看她们对这一切有什么感想……从一楼开始！

lines.en: scene fashionshow14
: Oh! I know Spanish! That means floor number one!
lines.zh: : 哦！我懂西班牙语！那是一楼的意思！

lines.en: : You don’t know Spanish, you know Despacito.
lines.zh: : 你不懂西班牙语，你只懂《Despacito》。

lines.en: : Sana...costume...
lines.zh: : Sana……服装……

lines.en: : You guys might have to hold me back so I don’t charge the stage.
lines.zh: : 你们可能得拦着我，不然我会冲上台去。

lines.en: : Sana Sakakibara’s costume was made by Ami Arakawa and Ayane Amamiya!
lines.zh: : Sana Sakakibara 的服装由 Ami Arakawa 和 Ayane Amamiya 制作！

lines.en: : Rin didn’t do anything to help, but she has decided to join them on the couch for the safety of both of our contestants!
lines.zh: : Rin 一点忙都没帮上，不过为了两位参赛者的安全，她决定一起坐到沙发上！

lines.en: : Is anyone else dizzy or is it just me?
lines.zh: : 有没有别人也头晕，还是只有我？

lines.en: scene fashionshow15
: I feel your pain, Rin. This is exactly what I have to wake up to every morning.
lines.zh: : 我懂你的感受，Rin。我每天早上醒来面对的就是这种场面。

lines.en: : I highly implore you to stop by and watch her sleep one day. I’m sure it is equally as cute as what you’re about to see.
lines.zh: : 我强烈建议你哪天来看看她睡觉的样子。我敢保证那跟你们马上要看到的一样可爱。

lines.en: : You are not making this easier for me, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你这样说只会让我更难受，Ayane。

lines.en: scene fashionshow16
: And over on the second floor couch is Molly MacCormack and Uta Ushibori!
lines.zh: : 二楼的沙发上坐着的是 Molly MacCormack 和 Uta Ushibori！

lines.en: : Wha- Uta? When did you-
lines.zh: : 什——Uta？你什么时候——

lines.en: : Yasuyasu’s outfit is a MacCormack original that she put a {i}lot{/i} of work into!
lines.zh: : Yasuyasu 这身衣服是 MacCormack 原创，她可是下了{i}大{/i}功夫的！

lines.en: : Please let me win. Please let me win. Please let me win. Please let me win. Please let me win.
lines.zh: : 让我赢吧。让我赢吧。让我赢吧。让我赢吧。让我赢吧。

lines.en: : I helped too! But really all I did was size her up and style her hair!
lines.zh: : 我也帮忙了！不过我真的只是给她量了尺寸、做了头发！

lines.en: : Also, please let it be known that any wardrobe malfunctions that happen today are the result of improper handling on behalf of the wearer! It is not our fault!
lines.zh: : 另外，请各位知悉，今天发生的任何服装走光都是穿着者操作不当造成的！不是我们的错！

lines.en: : Uta, get back over here! It feels weird standing on the stage alone!
lines.zh: : Uta，快回来！我一个人站在台上很奇怪！

lines.en: : Hold your friggin’ horses, prez! I’m givin’ my all as a field reporter over here!
lines.zh: : 别急嘛，会长！我这边的现场记者可是拼了老命在播报！

lines.en: : In fact, why don’t you just go ahead and introduce the contestants without me?!
lines.zh: : 事实上，你干脆就先自己介绍参赛选手吧！

lines.en: : I’ll hang out on the couch with my buddy Molly and make sure she doesn’t pop a blood vessel!
lines.zh: : 我要跟我的好搭档 Molly 一起窝在沙发上，确保她别把血管给爆了！

lines.en: : Um...uhh...okay! Yeah! On with the show and...all of that.
lines.zh: : 呃……嗯……好吧！行！那就……继续演出之类的。

lines.en: scene black
: T-Tonight’s first contestant is Sana Sakakibara!
lines.zh: : 今、今晚的第一位参赛者是 Sana Sakakibara！

lines.en: : Sana...come on out!
lines.zh: : Sana……出来吧！

lines.en: : Wooo! That’s my girl!
lines.zh: : 喔喔！那是我家的姑娘！

lines.en: : YEAAAAAAH SANA!!! YOU GOT THIS, BABY!!!
lines.zh: : 耶耶耶耶 SANA！！！你没问题，宝贝！！！

lines.en: : Ahhhhhhhhhhh.......
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: scene fashionshow17
: The motif behind Sana’s outfit is...
lines.zh: : Sana 这身衣服的设计主题是……

lines.en: : Actually, why don’t you go ahead and explain this part Ami? I can’t really tell what’s goin’ on here.
lines.zh: : 其实，这部分不如让 Ami 来解释吧？我实在看不出这里头是什么名堂。

lines.en: : Oh! Uhh...yeah!
scene fashionshow18
: The idea behind Sana’s costume is...umm...kind of a...contrast between dark and light?
lines.zh: : Sana 这套服装的理念是……嗯……算是……黑暗与光明的对比吧？

lines.en: : Sana’s really quiet and timid, but when she’s watching horror movies or playing D&D, she gets really into it and kinda turns into somebody else.
lines.zh: : Sana 平时很安静、很害羞，但她看恐怖片或者玩 D&D 的时候会特别投入，整个人简直像变了个人。

lines.en: : So I wanted to show off those parts of her and...also show everybody that she’s super cute when all of her skin isn't covered up.
lines.zh: : 所以我想把她的那一面展现出来……顺便也让大家看看，她不把自己裹得严严实实的时候有多可爱。

lines.en: : I see, I see! It {i}is{/i} true that Sana is revealing a bit more skin than normal! I can see her belly button from all the way over here!
lines.zh: : 原来如此，原来如此！Sana {i}确实{/i}比平时露得多了点！我从这边都能看见她的肚脐！

lines.en: scene fashionshow19
: S-Stop looking at it!
lines.zh: : 别、别盯着看！

lines.en: : I’m going to faint. She’s so cute. Oh my god. She’s the cutest thing in the world. I love her.
lines.zh: : 我要晕了。她太可爱了。天哪。她是世界上最可爱的东西。我爱她。

lines.en: : Haruka. Haruka. Haruka.
lines.zh: : Haruka。Haruka。Haruka。

lines.en: : What?...
: See that girl? I {i}made{/i} that. She came out of me.
lines.zh: : 看到那个女孩了吗？那是我{i}造{/i}出来的。她是从我身上出来的。

lines.en: : Yes...Good job, Sara. We’re all very proud of you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……干得好，Sara。我们都为你骄傲。

lines.en: : Sana, is there anything you’d like to say to the judge before we bring Yasu out?
lines.zh: : Sana，在 Yasu 出场之前，你有什么想对评委说的吗？

lines.en: scene fashionshow20
: To...Sensei?...
: Well, he {i}is{/i} the judge...
lines.zh: : 嗯，他{i}就是{/i}评委……

lines.en: : I’m...sorry you had to...see me like this...
lines.zh: : 很抱歉……让你看到我这副样子……

lines.en: : So modest! Could it be that Sana really doesn’t recognize her own cuteness?! Or is this a calculated move to play up her insecurities and steal the competition?!
lines.zh: : 太谦虚了！难道说 Sana 真的没有意识到自己有多可爱吗？！还是说这是刻意卖弄不安、好赢走比赛的算计呢？！

lines.en: : No, I’m...pretty sure she’s just embarrassed...
lines.zh: : 不，我……挺确定她只是害羞……

lines.en: : Either way! Thank you, Sana, for showing everyone your cuteness!
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！谢谢你，Sana，让大家看到了你的可爱！

lines.en: : Makoto, go ahead and bring Yasu out!
lines.zh: : Makoto，请 Yasu 出场吧！

lines.en: scene black
: Right! On it!
lines.zh: : 好的！马上！

lines.en: : Our second and final contestant tonight is Yasu Yasui!
lines.zh: : 今晚的第二位、也是最后一位参赛者是 Yasu Yasui！

lines.en: : She’s still the newest student in the class, but that doesn’t mean she’s coming into this with nothing riding on it!
lines.zh: : 她虽然是班里最新的学生，但这可不代表她这次毫无筹码！

lines.en: : Yasu...come on out!
lines.zh: : Yasu……出来吧！

lines.en: scene fashionshow21
: To repeat, Yasuyasu is wearing a MacCormack original! Did you hear that, folks? A {i}MacCormack{/i} original!
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，Yasuyasu 身上穿的是 MacCormack 原创！大家听到了吗？{i}MacCormack{/i} 原创！

lines.en: : Why is she making Molly sound like some sort of professional designer?
lines.zh: : 她干嘛把 Molly 说得像什么专业设计师似的？

lines.en: : Well...she {i}is{/i} really good, to be completely fair.
lines.zh: : 嗯……平心而论，她{i}确实{/i}很厉害。

lines.en: : Whose side are you even on?!
lines.zh: : 你到底站哪一边的啊？！

lines.en: : Molly, how about you tell us a little more about Yasu’s outfit tonight?
lines.zh: : Molly，你再给大家多讲讲 Yasu 今晚这身衣服？

lines.en: : Absolutely. What you see here is-
lines.zh: : 当然。各位眼前所看到的是——

lines.en: scene fashionshow22
: A tale as old as time itself~
lines.zh: : 一个与时间同样古老的故事~

lines.en: : Um...what I was saying is-
lines.zh: : 呃……我刚才想说的是——

lines.en: scene fashionshow23
: So many beautiful things packed into one room...and I am lucky enough to be beside them.
lines.zh: : 这么多美好的事物挤在同一个房间里……而我有幸站在它们身旁。

lines.en: : Feast your eyes upon me and witness the true wonder that is purity incarnate.
lines.zh: : 尽情注视我吧，见证纯洁化身所带来的真正奇迹。

lines.en: : For I, Yasu Yasui, have been chosen by Him to spread the seed...and to take all of you with me.
lines.zh: : 因为我，Yasu Yasui，被祂选中去传播种子……并且要带上你们所有人。

lines.en: scene fashionshow24
: Come! Let us watch the end of days from atop the highest building we can find!
lines.zh: : 来吧！让我们在能找到的最高的楼顶上，一起观看末日的降临！

lines.en: : So that even when the world plunges into darkness, we shall be above it!
lines.zh: : 这样一来，即便世界坠入黑暗，我们也将凌驾于其上！

lines.en: : Come to the light! Come! Come!
lines.zh: : 到光这边来！来吧！来吧！

lines.en: : Thanks a bunch, Yasuyasu! But now it’s Molly’s turn to talk!
lines.zh: : 非常感谢，Yasuyasu！不过现在该 Molly 说了！

lines.en: scene fashionshow25
: Good luck, Molly. And thank you very much for the dress.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运，Molly。也非常感谢你做的这条裙子。

lines.en: : You are very welcome...
lines.zh: : 不客气……

lines.en: : Now, as I was saying, the motif behind Yasu’s design is to emphasize the chaotic darkness growing within her.
lines.zh: : 那么，正如我刚才所说，Yasu 这身设计的主题，是强调她内心不断滋长的混沌黑暗。

lines.en: : Her patron, who I assume is the Great Old One-
lines.zh: : 她的庇护者，我猜应该是伟大的旧日支配者——

lines.en: : He with many eyes.
lines.zh: : 那位长着许多眼睛的祂。

lines.en: : Oh, I haven’t heard of that one before. You’ll have to tell me more about him.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个我还没听说过。你得再多跟我说说祂。

lines.en: : I would like nothing more.
lines.zh: : 我求之不得。

lines.en: : Anyway, the idea was to show everyone what I believe the physical manifestation of darkness to be.
lines.zh: : 总之，我的想法是想向大家展示，我心目中黑暗的具象化是什么样子。

lines.en: : But, just like with Sana’s costume, there needs to be an element of light. Or, in Yasu’s case, purity.
lines.zh: : 不过，和 Sana 那套一样，还是需要一个光明的元素。或者说，就 Yasu 而言，是纯洁。

lines.en: : Which is why we’ve adorned her with a crown and necklace of thorns.
lines.zh: : 所以我们给她戴上了一顶荆棘王冠和一条荆棘项链。

lines.en: : Mixed with her pale skin, the thorns are meant to signify corruption or how purity can be tainted by even the smallest of barbs...
lines.zh: : 再配上她苍白的肌肤，这些荆棘意在象征堕落，或者说是纯洁如何被最微小的倒刺所玷污……

lines.en: scene black
: Wonderful explanation, Molly! Thanks so much for sharing!
lines.zh: : 讲得太好了，Molly！非常感谢你的分享！

lines.en: : But, now that both contestants have showed us their outfits, it’s time for our favorite teacher in the whole wide world to decide who wins!
lines.zh: : 不过，既然两位参赛者都展示了服装，现在就由全世界我们最喜欢的老师来决定谁获胜了！

lines.en: : Sana, why don’t you join Yasuyasu back on the stage and-
lines.zh: : Sana，你也回到台上跟 Yasuyasu 站一起，然后——

lines.en: : Wait, Yasu, where are you going?
lines.zh: : 等等，Yasu，你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Stay here, Yasu. The contest isn’t over yet.
lines.zh: : 留在这儿，Yasu。比赛还没结束呢。

lines.en: : Contest?
lines.zh: : 比赛？

lines.en: : You...do realize why...
lines.zh: : 你……该不会是明白为什么……

lines.en: : You know what, nevermind. Just wait here.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。你就在这儿等着。

lines.en: : Sana, come back out!
lines.zh: : Sana，再出来一下！

lines.en: : Ahhhhh...do I have to?
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊……我一定要吗？

lines.en: : The hard part’s already over. Just stand next to Yasu for a minute or two, please.
lines.zh: : 最难的部分已经过去了。你就站在 Yasu 旁边待个一两分钟，拜托了。

lines.en: : Umm...uhh...okay...
scene fashionshow26
: Oh my. You look scared.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。你看起来很害怕。

lines.en: : What is wrong, Sana?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Sana？

lines.en: : I like your...crown...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你的……王冠……

lines.en: : As do I.
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢。

lines.en: : It’s made with real thorns.
lines.zh: : 那是用真的荆棘做的。

lines.en: scene fashionshow27
: Uhhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Wait, is Yasuyasu bleeding? Molly, that’s not supposed to happen, is it?
lines.zh: : 等等，Yasuyasu 在流血吗？Molly，这不应该发生吧？

lines.en: : It was...a risk I knew we’d be taking.
lines.zh: : 这……是我早就知道要冒的风险。

lines.en: : I suggested using one made from plastic, but Yasu was quite insistent on wearing an {i}actual{/i} crown of thorns.
lines.zh: : 我建议过用塑料做的，但 Yasu 非常坚持要戴{i}真的{/i}荆棘王冠。

lines.en: : Uhh...Y...Yasu...your forehead is...
lines.zh: : 呃……Y……Yasu……你的额头……

lines.en: : He would be so proud of you, Sana.
lines.zh: : 祂一定会为你感到骄傲的，Sana。

lines.en: : You’ve come so far.
lines.zh: : 你已经走了这么远。

lines.en: scene fashionshow28
: Who are you...talking about?...
lines.zh: : 你在说……谁？……

lines.en: : You want to know?
lines.zh: : 你想知道吗？

lines.en: : I...don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道……

lines.en: : Whenever you do, feel free to come find me.
lines.zh: : 等你想知道了，随时来找我。

lines.en: : I can show you things that will change your life.
lines.zh: : 我可以让你看到改变你一生的东西。

lines.en: : Things that will save you.
lines.zh: : 能够拯救你的东西。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Okay...
scene fashionshow29
: Okay, Sensei! Make your choice!
lines.zh: : 好了，老师！做出你的选择吧！

lines.en: : Who is the winner of the fashion show?!
lines.zh: : 时装秀的获胜者是谁？！

lines.en: I take one final look at Sana and Yasu and wish I could give the win to both of them.
lines.zh: 我最后看了一眼 Sana 和 Yasu，真希望这个胜利能同时给她们两个人。

lines.en: Unfortunately, a decision needs to be made.
lines.zh: 可惜，必须做出选择。

lines.en: And, so...
lines.zh: 于是……

lines.en: menu:
Sana wins
lines.zh: Sana 获胜

lines.en: $ dorm1warpoints += 1
$ sanafashion = True
: The winner of the gothic lolita fashion show is...
lines.zh: : 哥特萝莉时装秀的获胜者是……

lines.en: : Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。

lines.en: scene fashionshow30
: W-Wait...really? I...I won?...
lines.zh: : 等、等等……真的吗？我……我赢了？……

lines.en: : So...so does that mean...you think my outfit is...prettier than Yasu’s?...
lines.zh: : 那……那是不是意味着……你觉得我的衣服……比 Yasu 的更好看？……

lines.en: : That is what winning would imply, yes.
lines.zh: : 是的，赢了就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Sana. I’m very happy for you.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Sana。我为你感到高兴。

lines.en: : Yasu, why couldn’t you wait until after the decision to start bleeding?! Your weak skin has ruined our chances of victory!
lines.zh: : Yasu，你为什么不能等结果出来再开始流血？！你那脆弱的皮肤毁了我们的胜算！

lines.en: scene fashionshow31
: I’m sorry, Molly. I am a very weak and delicate girl.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Molly。我是个非常柔弱的女孩。

lines.en: : I...I don’t really know what to say...
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道该说什么……

lines.en: : Say that you couldn’t have done it without me and Ayane!
lines.zh: : 就说没有我和 Ayane 你根本做不到！

lines.en: : I’m so proud...that’s my girl up there...
lines.zh: : 我太骄傲了……台上那是我家的姑娘……

lines.en: : Haruka. Haruka. Haruka.
lines.zh: : Haruka。Haruka。Haruka。

lines.en: : Did you see what happened?
lines.zh: : 你看到发生了什么吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Sara. We’re all very happy for her.
lines.zh: : 看到了，Sara。我们都为她高兴。

lines.en: : My daughter just won a fashion show. How many fashion shows have you won?
lines.zh: : 我女儿刚赢了一场时装秀。你赢过几场时装秀？

lines.en: : None, Sara. Congratulations on giving birth to a cute girl.
lines.zh: : 一场也没有，Sara。恭喜你生了个可爱的女儿。

lines.en: : Thank you very much~
lines.zh: : 非常感谢~

lines.en: : Um...thank you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢你，老师……

lines.en: : For...choosing me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……选择了我。

lines.en: : You don’t have to thank me. I just picked the person who I thought should win and...that person happened to be you.
lines.zh: : 你不用谢我。我只是选了我认为该赢的人……而那个人刚好是你。

lines.en: : You look very cute, Sana.
lines.zh: : 你看起来非常可爱，Sana。

lines.en: : Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……

lines.en: : I’m...really happy you think that...
lines.zh: : 你能这么想……我真的很开心……

lines.en: Yasu wins
lines.zh: Yasu 获胜

lines.en: $ dorm2warpoints += 1
$ yasufashion = True
: The winner of the gothic lolita fashion show is...
lines.zh: : 哥特萝莉时装秀的获胜者是……

lines.en: : Yasu.
lines.zh: : Yasu。

lines.en: : I won something?
lines.zh: : 我赢了什么？

lines.en: : YEAAAAH! VICTORY FOR MOLLY!
lines.zh: : 耶耶耶！胜利属于 MOLLY！

lines.en: : And Yasuyasu, Molly. She’s the one who wore the outfit.
lines.zh: : 还有 Yasuyasu 啦，Molly。衣服是她穿的。

lines.en: : Yes, but {i}I’m{/i} the one who did all the work. This one belongs to the people of Ireland.
lines.zh: : 没错，可所有的工作都是{i}我{/i}做的。这场胜利属于爱尔兰人民。

lines.en: : Damn it! I worked really hard on that dress!
lines.zh: : 可恶！那条裙子我可是下了大功夫的！

lines.en: : I still think Sana should have won. She’s clearly the cuter girl out of the two of them.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得该 Sana 赢。她们俩里她明显更可爱。

lines.en: : And significantly less scary. I vote Sana.
lines.zh: : 而且没那么吓人。我投 Sana。

lines.en: : Sensei! We demand a recount!
lines.zh: : 老师！我们要求重新计票！

lines.en: scene fashionshow33
: Does this mean what I think it means, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 这是不是我想的那个意思，老师？

lines.en: : What do you think it means, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 你觉得是什么意思，Yasu？

lines.en: : That if we were to conduct the act of transference among all of these beautiful creatures, you would supplant me with His warmth before the others?
lines.zh: : 就是说，如果我们要在这些美丽的生灵之间进行那场传递仪式，你会先于其他人，用祂的温暖填满我？

lines.en: : That is...not how I would word it.
lines.zh: : 这个……我可不会这么措辞。

lines.en: : Is it because you can sense how empty it is inside of me? How I long to spread the seed?
lines.zh: : 是因为你能感觉到我内心有多空虚吗？感觉到我有多渴望传播种子？

lines.en: : It’s because I thought you looked cuter.
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得你看起来更可爱。

lines.en: : But, Sana-
lines.zh: : 不过，Sana——

lines.en: scene fashionshow34
: Y...Yeah?
lines.zh: : 嗯……怎么了？

lines.en: : I think you look really cute as well.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得你非常可爱。

lines.en: : I just think this win should go to Yasu instead.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得这场胜利应该归 Yasu。

lines.en: scene fashionshow35
: No...I...I agree...
lines.zh: : 不……我……我也这么觉得……

lines.en: : I’m just...sad that I couldn’t get...a point for Ami and Ayane...
lines.zh: : 我只是……有点难过，没能替 Ami 和 Ayane 拿到……那一分……

lines.en: : They really tried to...win this competition and...and I couldn’t do it for them...
lines.zh: : 她们真的很想……赢下这场比赛，可我……没能替她们做到……

lines.en: : Oh my...
lines.zh: : 哎呀……

lines.en: : Could this be...arousal?...
lines.zh: : 这难道是……心动的感觉？……

lines.en: : I’m beginning to feel...rather lightheaded...
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得……有点头晕……

lines.en: : You’re also losing blood, so we should probably get you patched up...
lines.zh: : 你还在流血呢，我们大概得先帮你包扎一下……

lines.en: scene black
Floor 1: [dorm1warpoints]\nFloor 2: [dorm2warpoints]
lines.zh:
一楼：[dorm1warpoints]
二楼：[dorm2warpoints]

lines.en: : Okay, everybody! Now that the fashion contest is over, feel free to order whatever you want!
lines.zh: : 好了各位！时装比赛已经结束，想点什么都随便点！

lines.en: : Also, this never happened! Please talk to one of the moms if you are feeling strange or want to lay down!
lines.zh: : 另外，今晚的事就当没发生过！如果觉得不舒服或者想躺一会儿，就去找在场的某位妈妈！

lines.en: : Uhh...Wakana, maybe we should start heading out? I don’t really think we should hang around for this.
lines.zh: : 呃……Wakana，我们是不是该走了？我觉得我们不该留下来看这个。

lines.en: : In a moment. I’d like to speak to the Sakakibara girl first.
lines.zh: : 等一下。我想先跟 Sakakibara 家那个女孩说句话。

lines.en: : Am I late? Did I miss the contest?
lines.zh: : 我迟到了吗？我错过比赛了吗？

lines.en: : I wanted to take a bath before I arrived and-
lines.zh: : 我来之前想先泡个澡，然后——

lines.en: : Wait, Yasu?! What on earth happened to your head?!
lines.zh: : 等等，Yasu？！你的头到底怎么回事？！

lines.en: $ dormwar15 = True
jump dormwar16
